about.description: 🔥 1Panel is a modern, open-source Linux server management panel and a lightweight AI management platform.
about.head: d2bb381

name: v2.3.2
body:
[English](#en-v2.3.2) | [中文](#cn-v2.3.2)

New Features

* Panel Settings: Added support for creating multiple API keys by @lan-yonghui in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/13872 * Virtual Machine Management: Added support for mounting multiple CD-ROM ISO images by @ssongliu ### Enhancements * Overview: Improved logging for disk command failures by @ssongliu in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/13889 * File Browser: Improved task messages for file copy, move, compress, and decompress by @lan-yonghui in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/13885 * Firewall: Optimized firewall state reads and batch verification logic by @ssongliu in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/13881 * System: Removed the minimum upgrade backup copies limit by @ssongliu in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/13907 ### Bug Fixes * Models: Fixed the Ollama page failing to open properly in some scenarios by @zhengkunwang223 in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/13855 * Models: Fixed vLLM uninstall failures in some scenarios by @zhengkunwang223 * App Store: Fixed application upgrade failures in some scenarios by @zhengkunwang223 in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/13888 * Websites: Fixed incorrect priority between HTTP-to-HTTPS redirects and website redirects by @A-Words in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/13847 * Certificates: Fixed auto-renewing certificates still triggering expiry alerts by @lan-yonghui in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/13895 * File Browser: Fixed file rename failures in some scenarios by @lan-yonghui in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/13891 * Firewall: Fixed IPv6 forwarding being disrupted by RA by @ssongliu in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/13882 * Firewall: Fixed incomplete batch operation and task logs by @ssongliu in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/13886 * Firewall: Fixed incorrect reporting of port allowances and whitelist synchronization by @ssongliu in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/13892 * Firewall: Fixed rule synchronization failures in some firewalld scenarios by @ssongliu in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/13896 * Log Audit: Fixed SSH login logs not being displayed in the server timezone by @wanghe-fit2cloud in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/13869 * Virtual Machine Management: Fixed abnormal display of some virtual machine states and the inability to wake sleeping virtual machines by @ssongliu in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/13890 * Virtual Machine Management: Fixed incorrect CPU topology settings for virtual machines by @ssongliu

新增功能

* 【面板设置】支持创建多个 API Key by @lan-yonghui in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/13872 * 【虚拟机管理】支持挂载多个 CD-ROM ISO 镜像 by @ssongliu ### 功能优化 * 【概览】完善磁盘命令执行失败时的日志记录 by @ssongliu in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/13889 * 【文件】完善文件复制、移动、压缩和解压任务的消息提示 by @lan-yonghui in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/13885 * 【防火墙】优化防火墙状态读取及批量校验逻辑 by @ssongliu in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/13881 * 【系统】移除最低升级备份副本数限制 by @ssongliu in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/13907 ### 问题修复 * 【模型】修复了部分场景下 Ollama 页面无法正常打开的问题 by @zhengkunwang223 in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/13855 * 【模型】修复了部分场景下 vLLM 卸载失败的问题 by @zhengkunwang223 * 【应用商店】修复了部分场景下应用升级失败的问题 by @zhengkunwang223 in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/13888 * 【网站】修复了 HTTP 跳转 HTTPS 与网站重定向优先级异常的问题 by @A-Words in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/13847 * 【证书】修复了自动续签证书仍触发到期告警的问题 by @lan-yonghui in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/13895 * 【文件】修复了文件重命名操作在部分场景下异常的问题 by @lan-yonghui in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/13891 * 【防火墙】修复了 IPv6 转发受 RA 干扰的问题 by @ssongliu in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/13882 * 【防火墙】修复了批量操作与任务日志显示不完整的问题 by @ssongliu in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/13886 * 【防火墙】修复了端口放行与白名单同步上报异常的问题 by @ssongliu in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/13892 * 【防火墙】修复了 firewalld 环境下部分场景规则同步异常的问题 by @ssongliu in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/13896 * 【日志审计】修复了 SSH 登录日志未按服务器时区显示的问题 by @wanghe-fit2cloud in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/13869 * 【虚拟机管理】修复了部分虚拟机状态显示异常及休眠虚拟机无法唤醒的问题 by @ssongliu in https://github.com/1Panel-dev/1Panel/pull/13890 * 【虚拟机管理】修复了虚拟机 CPU 拓扑设置不正确的问题 by @ssongliu
